notes.title: Demo v0.0.6.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are going to participate in the Steam Next Fest and to celebrate we brought the HEAT!!!

If you are finding the game too easy and winning too much, now you have the option to increse the intensity. There will be [b]More [/b]enemies and they will be [b]Harder[/b], [b]Better[/b], [b]Faster[/b], [b]Stronger[/b]


When you feel ready now you can select an Anomaly to change the way you play the game.
[list]
[*][b]Late To The Party[/b] - You arrived late and the orbital bombardment already started
[*][b]Lethal Environment[/b] - Receive damage continously but the enemies drop extra HP items.
[*][b]Jammed Weapon[/b] - Your Main Weapon is Jammed but you get more weapons.
[*][b]MORE!!![/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.5.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

A favorite among our community and a prominent figure in our Main Menu, She has been a highly requested addition.

We want to welcome our newest Agent [b]"The Hare"[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44293707/ab5298aaebca296740d84d990659625af8b6993f.gif[/img]

After some intense training, we were able to unleash our Agents active skills. Now each Agent will bring its own unique ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44293707/c5adc5472d4b753d752ca4be4f19e76867de824f.gif[/img]

Checking the armory behind a rusty crate we found the awesome [b]Akimbo Pistols[/b] which will let you practice your Gun Kata.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44293707/22fad5c08bc2a2f9c1a38e338257bf5bfae45baf.gif[/img]

Using all your feedback and seeing how people played the game we adjusted the balance of the game and the player progression, right now we feel the pacing is much better and will give you a better experience.

In order to bring you the best possible experience, we have to reset your savegame.
This will help us greatly to reduce possible errors as we're still under development.
Thank you for understanding and we hope that improvements that we made make you enjoy our game even more.

notes.title: Demo v0.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
We added [b]auto-aim[/b] for the main weapons as an optional feature.

You can select manual or auto aim when starting a run, or by changing it via options.
You can also toggle auto aim while playing by using the Tab key, or the Right Shoulder via gamepad.

If you have auto-aim enabled, you can still manually aim by pressing the mouse left click and it will start auto aiming again when you release, and using the gamepad if you aim with the right stick it will use your manual aim and return to auto aim on release.

We received a request to have an option to turn off [b]Screen Shake[/b] and we added that to the options menu.

We added instructions for playing with gamepad, and now the instructions are visible on the pause screen as well.

notes.title: Join the Cleanup Crew in this FREE DEMO!!!
notes.notes:
Are you ready to land the most unique job of your life as part of the Cleanup Crew?

Ever wondered if those adorable teddy bears, ponies, and fairies were hiding something sinister beneath their charm?

Well, now's your chance to uncover the truth! If you're brave enough, step into the shoes of one of our fearless Agents and embark on a thrilling mission to vanquish these once-cute creatures.

Here's what awaits you:

🔥 Two Unforgettable Agents: Choose between The Scavenger and The Biohazard (even his suit can't contain the stench!)

🔫 Four Main Weapons: Arm yourself with the Bug Buster, Skull Piercer, Master Exploder, and Molecular Slicer to obliterate your foes.

🤖 Automated Weapons: Discover a range of cutting-edge automated weapons to make your battle even more epic.

💪 Perks: Unlock unique perks to enhance your abilities and increase your chances of survival.

Your mission? Survive the onslaught and make a daring escape before the ultimate threat, Planet Bombardment, strikes!

Join us in this action-packed adventure and prove your mettle as a Cleanup Crew Agent. Are you up for the challenge? Try the demo now and uncover the dark secrets lurking behind the fluff and magic!
